title: Learning disability and autism
summary: Support for autistic people and people with a learning disability, checked against CQC’s right support, right care, right culture.
whenToUse: Every six months for services supporting autistic people or people with a learning disability, and before registering a new service.

statements.focus: Right support: choice, control and independence in everyday life.
Right care: person-centred support that protects dignity, privacy and human rights.
Support plans built with the person, with goals and how they communicate.
Restrictive practices: any restraint or restriction recorded, reviewed and reduced.
Decisions made with the person, and capacity and best-interest records where needed.
Access to health checks and community life on the same terms as others.
Right culture: leaders’ and staff’s values, and how a closed culture would be spotted.
